settings.title: Kitchen cupboards
settings.text: Shelf risers, turntables and drawer dividers.

settings.title: Shipped from UK stock
settings.text: We only list products held in UK warehouses, with tracked delivery. Estimates are shown on every product page.

settings.title: Real measurements
settings.text: Every listing shows the supplier's dimensions and materials so you can check it fits before you buy.

settings.title: Your rights, clearly explained
settings.text: Change your mind within 14 days of delivery. Faulty items are covered by the Consumer Rights Act.

settings.heading: How delivery works
settings.text:
When you order, we pass your order to our UK-based supplier — normally within one working day. Your parcel is sent from a UK warehouse with a tracked service, and we email the tracking number as soon as the supplier dispatches it.

Read our delivery policy

settings.question: Where do you deliver?
settings.answer: We currently deliver to addresses in Great Britain. Delivery estimates from our UK suppliers are shown on each product page and at checkout.

settings.question: Will I get tracking?
settings.answer: Yes. As soon as the supplier dispatches your order we email you the carrier and tracking number.

settings.question: Can I return something if I change my mind?
settings.answer: Yes. You can cancel within 14 days of receiving your item. Contact us first and we will send the correct returns address. See our returns policy.

settings.question: Do the products need drilling?
settings.answer: Most of our range is chosen to be renter-friendly. Each product page says clearly how it fits.
